description: BOOMERANG was a balloon-borne microwave telescope and total-power receiver built to map cosmic microwave background anisotropy from a long-duration balloon.
facility_description: BOOMERANG flew a 10.5 day stratospheric flight from McMurdo Station, Antarctica.
notes: No requested acknowledgement was found. The only reuse terms opened for the article are the arXiv non-exclusive licence, which does not grant further reuse and says to contact the author. That is not a grant to redistribute a separate numeric curve. No magnitude system was recorded.
